ConnectionStrings.// workpilotdb: Local `dotnet run` from AppHost injects this automatically via Aspire service discovery (its own dev Postgres container). For a non-Aspire run against the real self-hosted Supabase stack (`docker compose up` in supabase/), set this explicitly to the SAME Postgres instance/database Supabase's own db container exposes, matching supabase/.env's POSTGRES_PORT (5433, not 5432, to avoid colliding with a local system Postgres) and POSTGRES_PASSWORD, e.g.: Host=localhost;Port=5433;Database=postgres;Username=postgres;Password=<POSTGRES_PASSWORD from supabase/.env>

Ai.// Purposes: Which provider and model answers each AI purpose (docs/specs/0006-ai-provider-abstraction). Default is the fallback for any purpose not listed (known: Default, Planner). Provider "Fake" is a deterministic no network stand in, so a fresh clone and the tests run with no key. Switch with e.g. Ai__Purposes__Default__Provider=deepseek and Ai__Purposes__Default__Model=deepseek-chat, then restart.
Ai.// ApiKey: Never put an ApiKey in this file. Development: dotnet user-secrets set "Ai:Providers:openai:ApiKey" <key> --project src/WorkPilot.Api. Production: the Ai__Providers__openai__ApiKey env var. Only providers some purpose uses need a key.
